title: Hybrid reservoir + stratified sampling for per-domain calibration sketchpacks
creator: Carlos Rivera
description:
Goal: produce stable, audit-friendly per-domain calibration sketchpacks used to generate FP8/INT8 quantization profiles for production models.

Motivation: Current calibration packs over/under-represent long-tail prompt types and mutable context prefixes used in customer workloads. This leads to mismatch between quantized model behaviour in nightly runs and real traffic, producing accuracy regressions. We will build a hybrid sampling strategy (reservoir sampling + stratified bucketing + context-aware dedup) to assemble compact per-domain packs (~5k-20k prompts depending on domain) that preserve distributional properties relevant to quantization (sequence length, prefix tokens, syntactic constructs, tokenization id patterns).
acceptance_criteria:
- Per-domain sketchpacks generated for top 12 production domains.
- Each pack includes metadata: domain, sequence_length_histogram, token-id-topk, canonical-prompts (n=100), synthetic-augmented prompts flagged.
- Quantization calibration runs (FP8 and INT8) using these packs show <=1.5% delta on domain-specific task metrics vs full-precision baseline for 10/12 domains; remaining 2 domains have runbooks.
- Automated pack build pipeline committed behind feature flag with unit/integration tests and scheduled nightly snapshot job.
- Documentation + Confluence PR with sampling knobs and recommended defaults.
decisions:
- Use hybrid reservoir sampling per domain to bound memory while preserving recency and rare-event capture.
- Stratify within domain by sequence-length buckets (0-64,65-128,129-256,256+) and a top-token-id quintile feature to preserve token-distribution tails.
- Apply context-normalization to remove PII and standardize variable placeholders before deduplication.
- Synthetic augmentation limited to paraphrase x1 and slot-swaps x2; flagged in pack metadata to avoid contaminating production evals.
tradeoffs:
- Reservoir sampling reduces memory but introduces stochasticity in packs across runs; mitigated with deterministic RNG seeds for production builds.
- Stratification increases complexity and makes packs larger for domains with multimodal length distributions. We accept slightly larger packs to keep calibration quality.
- Synthetic augmentation improves coverage but risks introducing distribution shift; thus limited and isolated in metadata.
implementation_plan:
1) Data extractor job: query production prompt store for domain-tagged prompts (last 90 days), apply context-normalization and tokenization.
2) Build module: run per-domain reservoir sampler with stratified sub-buckets, apply dedupe, tag canonical examples.
3) Augmentation step: generate paraphrases and slot-swaps for low-frequency buckets, flag augmented records.
4) Pack serializer: emit ndjson with metadata header + metrics summary, push to s3 path s3://redwood-calibration/packs/{domain}/{date}/pack.ndjson.
5) CI + nightly orchestrator workflow (dag) + feature flag gating.
6) Integrate with quantization harness to run FP8/INT8 calibration and collect metrics.
7) Rollout: shadow runs for 2 weeks, then staged canary into automated profile library if metrics within thresholds.
validation_plan:
- Run quantization calibration on each pack for target model (gpt-ish baseline v2). Collect: per-token perplexity delta, top-1 token match, embedding cosine drift on a holdout eval set, and downstream task metrics where available.
- Establish per-domain pass criteria (see acceptance).
- Track calibration stability across 7 consecutive nightly builds (seeded).
- If domain fails, trigger automated shrink/expand flow: increase pack size for failing buckets by 2x and re-run.
- Maintain a dashboard (Grafana) with per-domain charts and alerting hooks for regression > threshold.
metrics:
- Pack size (examples)
- Sequence length distribution KL vs live traffic
- Token-id frequency Spearman correlation vs live traffic
- FP8/INT8 vs FP32: top-1 token match percent, perplexity ratio, downstream task F1/accuracy delta
- Stability: variance of calibration profile parameters across 7 runs
